title: Post-Week 6 People's Panic Meter: Is it over for AJ Brown, CeeDee Lamb & George Pickens?!

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Post-Week 6 People's Panic Meter: Is it over for AJ Brown, CeeDee Lamb & George Pickens?!
sources.description: The panic levels are rising after another week of shocking and disappointing fantasy performances! Matt Harmon and Justin Boone are back to tackle your biggest fantasy concerns, taking your submissions and determining which players are actually worth panicking over after a subpar Week 6. The two also dive into the top 10 waiver wire targets for Week 7, highlighting the players who could make an immediate impact on your fantasy roster, plus the candidates you should consider dropping as you look to improve your team heading into Week 7.
